rule.name: SpringValidRequestBody
rule.message: Add @Valid to this @RequestBody; without it the record''s constraints are never checked.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FormalParameter[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[ (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.validation.Valid') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.validation.Valid')) or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated')])] [not(ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Number') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.InputStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.core.io.Resource') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode')])] [not(ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Optional')] /TypeArguments/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.CharSequence') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Number') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Object') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode')])] [not(ClassType/TypeArguments/WildcardType)] [not(ArrayType or PrimitiveType)]
